name: nav-sidebar
title: Nav Sidebar
description: Application UI pattern: the app's side navigation, as in the Claude apps: a logo row with the collapse button, a header for the tenant switcher and search, links in categories that open, close, show more and take an add action, badges, the current page, a footer for notifications, help and the account, NavSidebarButton rows (ghost, switcher, field) for those, and a collapsible icon rail with tooltips that previews the full sidebar on hover. One of the pieces an App Shell places.
